name: Kashnia Blood Claussell
original_name: カシュニア=ブラッド=クラウゼル
source:
Yggdrasil Magical Academy Second Year
Class: Vampire

A haughty, slightly delusional vampire, who gets upset when others call her “Kash-tan.” A typical airhead, she harbors a strange obsession with the [url=/c64356]protagonist[/url], declaring herself to be his rival as soon as he shows up. 

Kashnia fears nothing, and often gets herself into trouble trying to fight monsters that are more than she's able to handle. Despite her recklessness, she's always ready to help a person in need, and she's like a reliable older sister to the younger students.  

As a vampire, she naturally hates crosses, garlic, and holy water, but they don't kill her. Instead, they merely seem to cause her to go into heat!
